arguments.sql: SELECT l."JRNL_NO", SUM(l."DR_AMT") AS dr, SUM(l."CR_AMT") AS cr, SUM(l."DR_AMT")-SUM(l."CR_AMT") AS diff FROM "GLJRNL" l GROUP BY l."JRNL_NO" HAVING SUM(l."DR_AMT")<>SUM(l."CR_AMT")

SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_NO", i."VEND_CD", i."INV_AMT", i."JRNL_NO", j.dr_t, j.cr_t FROM "APINVH" i LEFT JOIN (SELECT "JRNL_NO", SUM("DR_AMT") dr_t, SUM("CR_AMT") cr_t FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY "JRNL_NO") j ON j."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" WHERE j."JRNL_NO" IS NULL OR ROUND(j.dr_t,2)<>ROUND(i."INV_AMT",2)

SELECT a."INV_ID", a.inv_no_n, a.vend_n FROM (SELECT "INV_ID", UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM("INV_NO"),'[^A-Za-z0-9]','','g')) inv_no_n, UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM("VEND_CD"),'[^A-Za-z0-9]','','g')) vend_n FROM "APINVH") a WHERE (a.inv_no_n, a.vend_n) IN (SELECT b.inv_no_n, b.vend_n FROM (SELECT UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM("INV_NO"),'[^A-Za-z0-9]','','g')) inv_no_n, UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM("VEND_CD"),'[^A-Za-z0-9]','','g')) vend_n FROM "APINVH") b GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)

SELECT h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", p."STRT_DT", p."END_DT", p."CLOSE_DT", p."STAT_CD" FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE h."POST_DT" NOT BETWEEN p."STRT_DT" AND p."END_DT" OR (p."STAT_CD"='C' AND h."POST_DT">p."CLOSE_DT")
SELECT p."PAY_ID", p."INV_ID", p."PAY_AMT", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD" FROM "APPAYM" p LEFT JOIN "APINVH" i ON i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID" WHERE i."INV_ID" IS NULL OR i."STAT_CD" NOT IN ('P','O')

SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", SUM(p."PAY_AMT") AS paid, i."STAT_CD" FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "APPAYM" p ON p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID" GROUP BY i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD" HAVING ROUND(SUM(p."PAY_AMT"),2)<>ROUND(i."INV_AMT",2)
SELECT l."JRNL_NO", l."ACCT_CD", c."ACCT_CD" AS coa, c."ACTV_FLG" FROM "GLJRNL" l LEFT JOIN "GLCOA" c ON TRIM(c."ACCT_CD")=TRIM(l."ACCT_CD") WHERE c."ACCT_CD" IS NULL OR TRIM(c."ACTV_FLG")<>'Y'
